summary: Albums, films and books I would push across the table at you, each with the one sentence I would say while doing it.

albums.title: OK Computer
albums.creator: Radiohead
albums.sentence: The album I play to anyone who says guitars ran out of ideas in the nineties.

albums.title: When the Pawn Hits the Conflicts He Thinks Like a King What He Knows Throws the Blows When He Goes to the Fight and He'll Win the Whole Thing 'Fore He Enters the Ring There's No Body to Batter When Your Mind Is Your Might So When You Go Solo, You Hold Your Own Hand and Remember That Depth Is the Greatest of Heights and If You Know Where You Stand, Then You Know Where to Land and If You Fall It Won't Matter, Cuz You'll Know That You're Right
albums.creator: Fiona Apple
albums.sentence: Ninety words of title and not one of them wasted, which is more than most records manage in forty minutes.

albums.creator: Sigur Rós
albums.sentence: Eight untitled songs sung in a language that does not exist, and I still know what every one of them means.

albums.title: 無罪モラトリアム
albums.creator: Ringo Sheena
albums.sentence: A debut that sounds like someone kicking the door in, even if you understand none of the Japanese.

albums.title: Lift Your Skinny Fists like Antennas to Heaven
albums.creator: Godspeed You! Black Emperor
albums.sentence: Four long pieces of slow orchestral rock, with an old man on Coney Island halfway through talking about how things used to be, that swell for twenty minutes at a time until the strings and three guitars and two drummers are all pushing on the same wall, and then fall back to almost nothing, which is exactly how a long night of debugging feels when the fix finally lands and the room goes quiet.

albums.title: Kind of Blue
albums.creator: Miles Davis
albums.sentence: Calmer than anything else I own, and the only word I have for it is Llanfairpwllgwyngyllgogerychwyrndrobwllllantysiliogogogoch: too long to say, worth every letter.

albums.title: UNFORGIVEN
albums.creator: LE SSERAFIM
albums.sentence: TODO: the one sentence you would say while handing this over.

films.title: Spirited Away
films.creator: Hayao Miyazaki
films.sentence: The film I rewatch when I need to remember that hard work and kindness can be the same thing.

films.title: جدایی نادر از سیمین
films.creator: Asghar Farhadi
films.sentence: A divorce hearing that turns into a thriller about truth, where every character is right and nobody is innocent.

films.title: Dr. Strangelove or: How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Bomb
films.creator: Stanley Kubrick
films.sentence: Proof that the funniest film ever made can also be the most frightening one.

films.title: Shoah
films.creator: Claude Lanzmann
films.sentence: Nine and a half hours with no archive footage, and the one film I would never put a rating on.

films.title: L'Arrivée d'un train en gare de La Ciotat
films.creator: Auguste and Louis Lumière
films.sentence: Fifty seconds of a train pulling into a station, and still the reason I think every film is a small magic trick.

films.title: The Room
films.creator: Tommy Wiseau
films.sentence: Half a star, fairly earned: I saw it in a cinema where the audience threw spoons at the screen, and it was the best night out of that year.

films.title: 8½
films.creator: Federico Fellini
films.sentence: A film about a director who cannot finish his film, and the best argument I know for shipping the unfinished thing.

books.title: Structure and Interpretation of Computer Programs
books.creator: Harold Abelson and Gerald Jay Sussman with Julie Sussman
books.sentence: The book that made "(define (square x) (* x x))" read like a sentence, & the reason I still write <3 in code reviews.

books.title: Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid
books.creator: Douglas Hofstadter
books.sentence: A seven-hundred-page argument that a mind is a loop, written as a fugue, and somehow fun the whole way through.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer
books.creator: Andrew Hunt and David Thomas
books.sentence: The book I hand every new engineer, mostly for the chapter about broken windows.

books.title: The Tale of Genji
books.creator: Murasaki Shikibu
books.sentence: Finished by about 1021, and it still reads like gossip from the next desk over.

books.title: Война и мир
books.creator: Лев Толстой
books.sentence: Long enough to read across a whole winter, and the battle chapters are the short part.

books.title: Cien años de soledad
books.creator: Gabriel García Márquez
books.sentence: Seven generations, one name used over and over, and a family tree I drew on the inside cover to keep up.

books.title: It
books.creator: Stephen King
books.sentence: Read it at twelve, slept with the light on for a month 🎈, and I would still recommend it.
